title: Data Scientist - eKYC
location: Ho Chi Minh City, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
description:
Trusting Social is an AI Fintech pioneer that's revolutionizing credit access in emerging markets. Our mission is "Advancing AI to Meet the Financial Needs of Everyday Consumers with Empathy." We've assessed over 1 billion consumers across four countries, and we're on a mission to provide 100 million credit lines using the power of AI and Big Data.
   

  

**How You'll Make An Impact**
 As a Data Scientist, eKYC at Trusting Social, you will be instrumental in building cutting\-edge digital identity verification products for our eKYC (electronic Know Your Customer) projects. Your expertise in machine learning and computer vision will be crucial for developing robust systems to prevent fraud and money laundering. This role offers the opportunity to make a significant impact on revenue while also enhancing financial security, aligning with our strong social mission.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Develop Advanced ML Models: Build various machine learning models in computer vision, implementing novel solutions for diverse ML problems (supervised, semi\-supervised, unsupervised, one\-class).
* Research \& Implement Cutting\-Edge Algorithms: Research, design, and implement advanced ML models and algorithms to solve practical problems, optimizing for both performance and speed.
* Build Practical Vision Systems: Work with high\-dimensional image and video data to develop practical vision systems with a direct impact on revenue and profitability.
* Optimize for Deployment: Optimize and deploy "tiny" ML solutions for limited computation power devices like mobile and web platforms.


**What We're Looking For**
 We need a qualified, proactive, and technically skilled Computer Vision Data Scientist:
   

  

* Educational Background: BS/MS/PhD. in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field.
* Experience: 4\+ years of experience in advanced Machine Learning, with a strong preference for experience in Computer Vision and Image Processing.
* Technical Proficiency: Must be proficient in Python and have experience with ML frameworks like TensorFlow, PyTorch, and ONNX.
* Problem\-Solving \& Insights: You're exceptional at asking the right questions that lead to actionable business insights, and you possess an aptitude for critically evaluating data outcomes, uncovering key insights, and challenging assumptions.
* Tooling Familiarity: Experience with managing data science and computer vision toolkits such as JupyterHub, CVAT, and OpenCV is a plus.
* Fundamental Understanding: A solid understanding of machine learning techniques and algorithms.
* Communication Skills: Ability to communicate complex quantitative analysis in a clear, precise, and actionable manner, coupled with great overall communication skills.
* Tech Adaptability: A keen interest and proven ability to leverage new technologies to enhance work quality and productivity.


**What We Offer**
 Join our vibrant team and enjoy:
   

  

* Competitive compensation, including 13th\-month salary and performance bonuses.
* Comprehensive health care coverage for you and your dependents.
* Generous leave policies and flexible work hours.
* Convenient District 1 office location (next to a future metro station).
* Onsite lunch with multiple options.
* Grab for work allowance and fully equipped workstations.
* Fun team\-building activities, sponsored sports clubs, and Thursday happy hours.
* Unlimited free coffee, tea, snacks, and fruit.
* A chance to make a profound social impact by helping to democratize credit access in emerging markets.


**Your Growth Journey at Trusting Social**
 At Trusting Social, we're invested in your professional development. You'll have the opportunity to:
   

  

* Learn from seasoned experts with over 15 years of industry experience.
* Accelerate your technical development and build a robust career in data science.
* Tackle a diverse range of cutting\-edge AI problems, including detection, classification, regression, OCR, LLM, anomaly detection, NLP, and generative models.
* Gain hands\-on experience across the full AI development lifecycle, from problem clarification and solution design to deployment, monitoring, and analysis of AI systems in production.
* Develop features for high\-impact digital identity verification products, including fraud prevention and anti\-money laundering solutions.
* Gain international exposure by learning from production deployments across diverse markets like Vietnam, the Philippines, India, and Indonesia.
* Collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams (product, infrastructure, engineering) to broaden your domain knowledge and enhance vital soft skills like communication, negotiation, and cross\-team collaboration.


 At Trusting Social, we live by ownership, integrity, and agility in execution. We believe in doing what's right, what's best, and what's innovative. If you're smart, driven, and want to make a difference in the world with the most advanced and fascinating technology, come join our team. We offer the runway to truly make an impact.

title: Tech Lead (Web3)
description:
We are hiring for one of our ecosystem projects at Asia's leading web3 venture studio. Our global team of researchers, engineers, designers, operators, and crypto veterans is \#BUIDLing the next digital economy. We are firm believers in the ethos and paradigm\-shifting potential of crypto. Our portfolio companies and advisory clients benefit from our long\-term, hands\-on approach, from concept to full\-fledged venture.
   

  

 We are seeking a passionate and skilled
 **Tech Lead** 
 to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will lead the technical vision, design, and development of innovative web3 projects, guiding a team of engineers to deliver scalable, secure, and high\-performance decentralized solutions that shape the future of the digital economy.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Lead Technical Strategy and Architecture: Define and drive the technical roadmap for web3 projects, designing scalable, secure, and high\-performance architectures for both frontend and backend systems. Oversee the integration of blockchain technologies, ensuring alignment with project goals and the company’s vision.
* Guide Development of Web Applications: Oversee the design and development of responsive, mobile\-friendly, and pixel\-perfect user interfaces using modern frameworks like React and TypeScript, as well as robust server\-side logic, APIs, and database integrations using Node.js and related technologies.
* Mentor and Lead Engineering Teams: Provide technical guidance and mentorship to a team of full stack and blockchain engineers, fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, and excellence. Conduct code reviews to enforce coding standards, best practices, and style guidelines.
* Drive Blockchain Integration: Lead the implementation of blockchain\-based functionalities, including wallet connectivity, smart contract interactions, and transaction processing, using tools like Ethers.js, Hardhat, or similar. Collaborate with blockchain engineers to ensure secure, efficient, and seamless integrations.
* Optimize Performance and Scalability: Champion best practices for optimizing application performance, including code bundling, caching, lazy loading, and database query optimization, to deliver fast, reliable, and scalable user experiences.
* Ensure Quality and Reliability: Develop and oversee comprehensive testing strategies, including unit tests, integration tests, and end\-to\-end tests, to ensure the reliability and quality of both frontend and backend systems.
* Collaborate Across Teams: Work closely with product managers, designers, and stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions. Communicate technical concepts effectively to non\-technical team members and align development efforts with project timelines and goals.
* Stay Ahead of Industry Trends: Keep abreast of emerging technologies, frameworks, and trends in web3, blockchain, and software development to ensure the team adopts cutting\-edge tools and practices.


**You Might Thrive In This Role If You Have**
* Educational Background: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
* Proven Technical Leadership: 8\+ years of experience in software development, with at least 2 years in a technical leadership or lead developer role, overseeing full stack or web3 projects. Expertise in React, TypeScript, and modern JavaScript frameworks; Node.js, Express, or similar frameworks; and RESTful API development with database management (e.g., MongoDB, PostgreSQL).
* Deep Blockchain Expertise: Strong understanding of blockchain concepts and hands\-on experience leading the integration of smart contracts and decentralized applications (dApps). Familiarity with tools like Ethers.js, Hardhat, or similar.
* Experience with Scalable Architectures: Proven ability to design and implement scalable, secure, and high\-performance architectures for web applications, with a focus on optimizing both frontend and backend systems.
* Leadership and Mentorship Skills: Demonstrated experience mentoring and leading engineering teams, fostering collaboration, and driving technical excellence. Ability to conduct effective code reviews and enforce best practices.
* Strong Problem\-Solving Skills: Proficiency in debugging, troubleshooting, and optimizing complex systems, with a focus on delivering high\-quality, secure, and scalable solutions.
* Excellent Communication: Exceptional communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders and work effectively in a fast\-paced, team\-oriented environment.
* Adaptability and Initiative: Self\-motivated, adaptable, and able to manage multiple priorities while guiding the team through changing project requirements and tight deadlines.

description:
Trusting Social is an AI Fintech pioneer that's revolutionizing credit access in emerging markets. Our mission is "Advancing AI to Meet the Financial Needs of Everyday Consumers with Empathy." Our goal is to build robust machine learning models that enhance user experience and optimize the profitability of our financial products.

* Train and Fine\-tune LLM Models: Develop and refine large language models to follow instructions, comprehend customer inquiries, and communicate naturally and effectively.
* Design and Develop LLM Agents: Create and tailor LLM agents to meet specific business needs and objectives.
* Build Evaluation Frameworks: Establish comprehensive evaluation frameworks to assess the performance and effectiveness of LLM agents.
* Feedback Collection and Model Improvement: Develop systems for collecting user feedback and iteratively improving model performance based on this feedback.

* Collaboration and Consultation: Work closely with peers, colleagues, and managers to resolve issues and achieve shared goals.

* From 6\+ years of professional working experience in applying applying statistical and ML solutions to business problems
* Strong proficiency in programming languages such as Python or R.
* Strong knowledge and hands\-on experience on machine learning, or statistics and experimentation
* Results oriented with strong analytical and problem solving skills
* Good business acumen with strong ability to solve business problems through data driven quantitative methodologies
* The ability to communicate results clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences
* Demonstrated ability to research and innovate solutions to solve business problems

title: Senior Data Scientist
company: Ngân hàng TMCP Đông Nam Á - SEABANK
description:
🚀 The Mission
 



 SeABank is scaling its Advanced Analytics capabilities to drive hyper\-personalization for millions of customers. We are seeking a Senior Data Scientist who bridges the gap between complex algorithms and real\-world banking revenue.
 



 In this role, you will move beyond manual model training. You will leverage AutoML to accelerate experimentation and build robust MLOps pipelines to deploy Propensity, NBO (Next Best Offer), and NBA (Next Best Action) models at scale.
 



 🔥 Key Responsibilities
 



 1\. Advanced Customer Analytics (Propensity \& Personalization)
 



 • Propensity Modeling: Design and deploy high\-precision models to predict customer likelihood to purchase (Credit Cards, CASA, Loans, Insurance) using comprehensive behavioral data.
 



 • NBO \& NBA Engines: Build recommendation systems (Next Best Offer / Next Best Action) to deliver the right message, to the right customer, at the right time across digital and physical channels.
 



 • Customer Lifecycle AI: Develop models for Churn Prediction, Reactivation, and Uplift Modeling to optimize marketing spend and retention strategies for Retail and SME segments.
 



 2\. AutoML \& Efficiency Strategy
 



 • Accelerated Modeling: Utilize AutoML frameworks (e.g., H2O, FLAML, AutoGluon, or custom wrappers) to rapidly benchmark baselines, select features, and tune hyperparameters.
 



 • Standardization: Create reusable coding templates and libraries to reduce "Time\-to\-Model" for the broader data science team.
 



 3\. MLOps \& Model Lifecycle Management
 



 • End\-to\-End Deployment: Move models from Jupyter Notebooks to production environments using Docker/Kubernetes.
 



 • Model Monitoring: Implement monitoring solutions (detecting Data Drift, Concept Drift) to ensure model performance remains stable over time.
 



 • CI/CD for ML: Collaborate with Data Engineers to build automated retraining pipelines using tools like MLflow, Airflow, or Kubeflow.
 



 🎯 What We Are Looking For
 



 Core Technical Skills:
 



 • Experience: 3\+ years in Data Science with a proven track record in Banking, Fintech, or E\-commerce.
 



 • Programming: Mastery of Python (Pandas, Polars, Scikit\-learn) and SQL for complex data wrangling.
 



 • Modeling Expertise: Deep understanding of Ensemble methods (XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost) and Classification/Regression problems.
 



 • Business Solvers: Strong experience specifically with Propensity Scoring, Collaborative Filtering, and Segmentation.
 



 Operational Excellence (The "Must\-Haves"):
 



 • AutoML: Experience using AutoML tools to streamline the modeling process is highly preferred.
 



 • MLOps: Hands\-on experience with model registry, versioning, and deployment tools (e.g., MLflow, Docker).
 



 • Cloud \& Big Data: Familiarity with AWS/GCP or Spark/Hadoop ecosystems is a plus.
 



 💡 Why This Role Matters
 



 • Direct Impact: Your Propensity and NBO models will be the engine behind SeABank’s marketing campaigns and sales strategies.
 



 • Tech Freedom: We encourage the use of AutoML to remove repetitive tasks so you can focus on feature engineering and solving hard business problems.
 



 • Innovation: Join a team that values production\-grade code over research papers.
